key_insight: Policy gradients for masked diffusion language models should optimize both token prediction and the remasking decision, not just token likelihood.
engineering_relevance: This provides a more faithful RL training signal for diffusion-based LLMs, improving performance on reasoning and code generation without changing the core model family.
method: Formulate MDLM generation as a two-stage action MDP.
Decompose the policy gradient into a token term and a masking term.
Optimize both terms jointly to better capture generation order and remasking behavior.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art benchmark results, including 87.1% on GSM8K and 53.4% on MBPP.
watch_item: The method adds a second optimization component for remasking, which may increase training complexity and sensitivity to how the two gradient terms are balanced.
paper_title: Mask-Aware Policy Gradients for Diffusion Language Models
